traits.anchorage_per_stem_kg.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for European, Japanese and hybrid larch: C_reg 161 N m per kg of green stem, the mean over its four soil groups and three rooting depths and over those species, from tree-pulling tests (Nicoll et al. 2006 and others, listed in the Critical Resistive Moments vignette). A species with its own pulling tests states its own.

traits.crown_drag_at_rest.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for European, Japanese and hybrid larch: crown drag coefficient on the silhouette Cd = C u^-N with C 3.07, N 0.75, fitted between 10 and 25 m/s (means over those species), after Mayhead's (1973) wind-tunnel drag of whole trees and later studies (Streamlining and Drag vignette).

traits.note: Farjon (2017), Larix (printed pp. 497-498, 507-511): Rauh's model, branches spaced regularly up a monopodial trunk; deciduous needles spiral and remote on long shoots and in dense tufts on short shoots; seed cones single at short-shoot tips, more or less erect, even on hanging branches. Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 60), Larix: leaves "spirally arranged and remote on leading shoots, densely crowded on the lateral spur-like twigs"; its key to the family (p. 51) puts Larix under "Cones maturing the first year".
